name: KY-03
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent McGarvey's large financial advantage ($1.8M on hand)
No polls or expert ratings available
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to McGarvey: a 10-point Democratic lean, incumbency, and a dominant fundraising edge over an underfunded challenger. Markets agree, pricing his win chances near 96%, so the forecast stays at a Safe D margin of about 21 points.
model.watch: Any credible polling showing the Republican challenger within single digits, or a major late outside-spending push, would warrant moving this toward Likely D.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Louisville-area KY-03 leans Democratic by about 10 points, and first-term incumbent Morgan McGarvey is running for reelection with a substantial financial edge. He has raised over $1.6 million and holds $1.8 million on hand, while Republican Maria Rodriquez reports no significant fundraising on file. No general-election polls or expert ratings are available for the race.

Prediction markets give McGarvey roughly a 96% chance of winning, consistent with the district's fundamentals. With no evidence of a competitive challenge, the seat is expected to remain comfortably Democratic, though the absence of polling leaves some residual uncertainty.
